# Dvir Segal's Blog

> Dvir Segal is a staff software engineer writing about software development, engineering culture, career growth, debugging, Docker, .NET, and developer productivity.

The blog contains around 50 posts: practical guides (Docker, WPF, .NET tooling), career and growth essays (tech lead vs senior, mentoring, job search), and team culture pieces (code review, communication, retrospectives).

## Content

- [All posts](https://dvirsegal.github.io/posts/): Full archive of blog posts
- [About Dvir](https://dvirsegal.github.io/about/): Who Dvir is and what he works on

## Feeds and indexes

- [Sitemap](https://dvirsegal.github.io/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all pages
- [RSS](https://dvirsegal.github.io/index.xml): RSS feed of all posts
